## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed sector signals with Technology and Consumer Discretionary strong while Energy and Healthcare lag. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5) — mixed momentum suppresses a clear directional call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology lead: AVGO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +31.31%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +9.85% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +14.19% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY. Financials showing strength: MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +1.87%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weakness: XOM (1W: -4.62% | 1M: -5.23%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -5.03% | 1M: -1.98%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare lagging: LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples and Utilities also showing weakness, keeping market tone mixed.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +14.19% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +31.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — concentration risk elevated.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: OXY (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -5.94% | 1M: -7.23%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.99%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.36% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION, WFC (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +5.99%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Energy and selected Tech/security names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +14.19% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: TSLA, WFC, DE, HD show conflicting 1W vs 1M signals — MAJOR Divergence present; treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is leading but concentrated: NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +5.38%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND while PANW (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.99%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +4.81%, 1M: +6.00% — positive but leadership narrow.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive: MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +1.87%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +7.46%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: +2.67%, 1M: +9.92% — broad gains but select names show short-term pullbacks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare under pressure: UNH (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND as an outlier, but LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.86%, 1M: -0.63% — defensive characteristics absent.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Remain selective within a NEUTRAL backdrop: favor pockets of Technology and high-momentum Financials while reducing exposure to Energy and weak Healthcare names. Given narrow leadership and MAJOR Divergence, monitor for follow-through before expanding exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to confirm; MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and results confirmed. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND — negative catalyst and price match; XOM (1W: -4.62% | 1M: -5.23%) BELOW TREND — sector weakness persists.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +4.81% | 1M: +6.00%) — watch breadth within the sector. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -1.35%) and Healthcare (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -0.63%) — follow earnings/safety headlines.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND — hold 1W gains for continued upside; AAPL (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +5.38%) ABOVE TREND — watch for renewed breadth confirmation in Tech; TSLA (1W: +14.19% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY — require 1M turn positive to confirm reversal.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MS (+55): Morgan Stanley (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND — price confirms positive call. JNJ (+55): Johnson & Johnson (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverging, watch for catalyst follow-through. CVS (+60): CVS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND — bullish coverage exists but sentiment mixed (see bearish).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (-45): Eli Lilly (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative, at risk. CVS (-85): CVS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND — very bearish headline conflicts with other bullish headlines; divergence and event risk. VZ (-??): Verizon (1W: -4.86% | 1M: -10.33%) BELOW TREND — price confirms negative tone.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed — Growth and Value signals both present amid narrow leadership. Tech and select Financials showing relative strength: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: MAJOR Divergence across several large-cap names (TSLA, WFC, DE) and mixed news flows for CVS/LLY — monitor for confirmation before enlarging positions.
